scope: Existing owner preview and production development branch, not live customer/Railway deployment
verifiedBy: Automated DOM flow tests (jsdom) against the actual published iframe HTML downloaded live; not a physical Android-device or clinician test

voice.substitutionPolicy: No browser synthetic fallback or alternate voice

supersetPairing.behavior: Alternate 1 set of each chosen exercise per round, then rest. If unequal number of sets, extra sets remain standalone. No additional sets created.

tests.previousDefect: Two band sets vs three triceps sets caused exception; fixed to two alternating rounds plus remaining triceps set.

tests.result: Training cannot start without checkbox; user declaration is not medical verification
Logged sets persisted in localStorage and counted correctly across session
Restored next unfinished step and preserved preceding log entries, without inferring unfinished reps
Uncontrolled form checkbox forces session stop; warning remains visible; flagged set retained honestly
CSV and JSON download links invoked in simulated browser
Marcus voice ID in rep sprite and technique audio; no alternative voice
Reviewed media player loop disabled; 5s videos play once per set

limitations: The instructor videos are short approved demonstrations, not full physically performed 8-15-rep or four-boxing-set footage. Rep-by-rep counts are paced audio/text, not full avatar performances.
No access to camera or sensors; cannot see the user's body, automatically count actual repetitions, or assess correct form.
Exercise-specific technique voice is available as a separate continuous Marcus guide, not yet indexed automatically to each exercise.
Training logs currently reside in each local browser profile only; exported CSV/JSON can be backed up but cloud sync across devices is not built.
Clinician clearance for left medical boot and non-weight bearing cannot be checked by the app. Deployment gate remains closed.
Real Galaxy Fold/Android audio unlock, cross-origin video playback, browser background behavior and interruption recovery require physical-device validation.

Full workout programming includes pending unapproved movements (controlled arm reaches, seated row, rear-delt fly, hand/wrist prep), so the coached runner intentionally includes only owner-approved sources.
protect: Latest approved R3 lateral raise and three earlier explicitly accepted moving candidates
Rejected lat-pulldown sources never shown or imported
security: Device-local logs; no third-party CRM, trackers, camera stream, or backend credentials added.
